# The Eleven at Congaree & Penn

> The Eleven is a community of eleven ten-acre homesteads, called Claims, set within Congaree & Penn, a working farm at 11830 Old Kings Road, Jacksonville, Florida 32219. Owners have about 200 more acres of farm to wander, and Cary State Forest forms the northern border. Homes are designed in the Agrarian Revival style by a curated Collective of architects and builders.

## Key facts (November 2026)
- Eleven Claims of about ten acres each; nine remain. Claim No. 4 has closed; the first home is under construction on Claim No. 10.
- Claims are priced from $750,000 to $1,200,000, land only.
- Purchase: select a Claim, sign the Purchase & Sale Agreement with a $25,000 earnest deposit, close in 30 days or less.
- Custom homes typically take 18 to 24 months.
- Contact: John A. Hillman, Developer & Broker, 843.475.6686.

## Pages
- [The Eleven](https://elevenjacksonville.com/): overview, the land, the Register of Claims, life on the farm, architecture, questions
- [Journal](https://elevenjacksonville.com/journal/): essays on Agrarian Revival, farm life and owning a Claim
- [Why Every Beautiful Detail Works](https://elevenjacksonville.com/journal/why-every-beautiful-detail-works/): the six elements of Agrarian Revival architecture
- [Why We Stopped Adding and Started Preserving](https://elevenjacksonville.com/journal/why-we-stopped-adding-and-started-preserving/): the philosophy behind The Eleven
